name: cloudformation:UpdateStack
description: A principal with cloudformation:UpdateStack can modify an existing CloudFormation stack that has an administrative service role attached. CloudFormation stacks execute with the permissions of their service role, which often requires elevated privileges to manage infrastructure. By updating the stack template to include new IAM resources (such as an admin role with a trust policy allowing the attacker to assume it), the attacker can leverage the stack's elevated permissions to create resources they couldn't create directly. This is particularly insidious because it appears as legitimate infrastructure management activity.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Must have permission to update the target CloudFormation stack

additional.description: Discover existing stacks and poll for update completion
Retrieve current stack template for safe injection
Verify the escalated role was created by the stack update
Assume the newly created admin role

admin: A CloudFormation stack must exist with an administrative service role (e.g., AdministratorAccess or an equivalent custom policy)
The principal must have permission to update that specific stack
lateral: A CloudFormation stack must exist with a service role that has elevated permissions
The principal must have permission to update that specific stack

references.title: AWS IAM Privilege Escalation - Methods and Mitigation (Rhino Security Labs)

techniques: T1098.001 - Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Credentials

options.name: STACK_NAME
options.description: Name of the existing CloudFormation stack with an admin service role

options.name: PAYLOAD
options.description: Payload type for the injected CloudFormation resources (backdoor/attach-policy)

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for CloudFormation and IAM operations

options.name: ASSUME_ROLE
options.description: Attempt to assume the escalated role after the stack update completes

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: ARN of the CloudFormation stack's service role. When provided, used to derive the stack name during discovery if cloudformation:ListStacks is unavailable

options.name: ESCALATED_ROLE_NAME
options.description: Name for the escalated IAM role to create (auto-generated if empty)

options.name: TRUST_PRINCIPAL
options.description: ARN to trust in the escalated role's trust policy (defaults to caller ARN)

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Revert the stack update after execution by restoring the original template. Requires cloudformation:UpdateStack

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Create an IAM role with AdministratorAccess trusted by the attacker's principal via CloudFormation template
